references.name: Business / calling / loyalty card
references.distinction: Single stiff, two-sided card.
references.options: Width/height; corner radius or contour; caliper; stock color; face/back artwork; finish.
references.notes: Square, mini and rounded versions are presets of the same master.

references.name: Postcard / thank-you insert
references.distinction: Single card with independent front and reverse layouts.
references.options: Width/height; caliper; coated sides; face/back art; optional postal layout.
references.notes: Shares flat-card geometry with business cards; keep a distinct browseable preset.

references.name: Flat notecard / invitation / correspondence card
references.distinction: Unfolded stationery card, commonly paired with an envelope.
references.options: Width/height; caliper; writing surface; stock texture; envelope fit.
references.notes: Invitation and correspondence uses can share this form.

references.name: Letterhead / stationery sheet
references.distinction: Single unbound writing sheet.
references.options: Width/height; caliper and GSM; grain; opacity; front/back artwork.
references.notes: US and ISO formats should be dimension presets.

references.name: Flyer / sell sheet / flat instruction insert
references.distinction: Unfolded information sheet that can be packed loose.
references.options: Width/height; stock; print sides; minimum readable text; clearance inside packaging.
references.notes: Quick-start sheet is a semantic preset, not a new topology.

references.name: Poster / paper art print
references.distinction: Large printed sheet displayed flat or shipped rolled.
references.options: Width/height; caliper; coated/uncoated stock; edge/border; flat/rolled presentation.
references.notes: Fine-art substrates can be added as materials without changing the master.

references.name: Bookmark
references.distinction: Narrow card, optionally with a drilled hole.
references.options: Width/height; contour; corner radius; hole; caliper; two print faces.
references.notes: Tassel is a separate component.

references.name: Ticket / voucher with detachable stub
references.distinction: Card or sheet with a detachable perforated section.
references.options: Width/height; perforation position/pitch; caliper; numbering; print sides.
references.notes: Perforation is the useful structural distinction.

references.name: Flashcard / prompt-card deck
references.distinction: Ordered or unordered stack of individual printed cards.
references.options: Card size; radius; count; caliper; face/back mapping; optional drill hole.
references.notes: Treat deck, ring and tuck box as separate assembly parts.

references.name: Folded greeting / note card
references.distinction: Cardstock with a single fold and four printable panels.
references.options: Flat and folded size; fold axis; caliper; grain; four panel artworks.
references.notes: Top-fold and side-fold are orientation presets.

references.name: Half-fold brochure / four-page instruction leaflet
references.distinction: One fold divides a sheet into two panels.
references.options: Flat/folded dimensions; fold offset; caliper; panel order; inside/outside artwork.
references.referenceName: Printing for Less: Brochure Templates and Folds
references.notes: Structural reference and templates; choose a printer-specific production template later.

references.name: C-fold / letter-fold / tri-fold leaflet
references.distinction: Three panels with one nested inside.
references.options: Flat/folded dimensions; unequal panel widths; fold order; caliper; six print panels.
references.notes: Nested panel allowance should come from stock and printer.

references.name: Z-fold leaflet
references.distinction: Three panels with alternating folds.
references.options: Panel widths; fold directions; flat/folded dimensions; caliper; panel artworks.
references.notes: A three-panel member of the accordion family.

references.name: Accordion / concertina instruction manual
references.distinction: Four or more alternating panels form a compact stack.
references.options: Panel count/widths; height; caliper; folded stack thickness; fold directions; panel artwork.
references.referenceName: Printing for Less: Accordion Fold Brochures
references.notes: Useful instruction insert inside a retail carton. Size the folded footprint and paper stack.

references.name: Open gate-fold leaflet
references.distinction: Two outer panels close toward a wider center panel.
references.options: Center/wing widths; meeting gap; caliper; crease locations; print panels.
references.notes: Opening sequence differs from a C-fold.

references.name: Closed gate / double gate-fold leaflet
references.distinction: Gate-fold sheet folds again through its center.
references.options: Panel widths; nested clearances; crease sequence; caliper; front/back artwork.
references.notes: Keep open and closed states for preview.

references.name: Roll-fold leaflet
references.distinction: Successive panels wrap inward around the first panel.
references.options: Progressive panel widths; fold sequence; caliper; folded depth; panel artwork.
references.notes: Inner panels need compensation for nesting.

references.name: Double-parallel fold leaflet
references.distinction: Sheet folds in half, then in half along a parallel axis.
references.options: Flat/folded size; fold positions; nesting allowance; caliper; panel artwork.
references.notes: Useful compact instruction-sheet preset.

references.name: French / quarter / cross-fold sheet
references.distinction: Two folds at right angles reduce the sheet to quarters.
references.options: Flat/folded size; perpendicular crease axes; fold sequence; caliper; printed sides.
references.referenceName: Printing for Less: Quarter Fold Brochures
references.notes: Useful map, poster and instruction-sheet preset.

references.name: Half-fold then tri-fold map / instruction sheet
references.distinction: Cross-axis combination makes a large sheet pocket-sized.
references.options: Crease network; sequence; panel allowances; final footprint; caliper; panel mapping.
references.notes: Map is a use case, not a requirement to create a different geometry system.

references.name: Saddle-stitched booklet / zine / manual
references.distinction: Folded sheets are nested and stapled through the spine.
references.options: Trim size; page count; stock/caliper; cover type; staple positions; creep; open/closed state.
references.notes: Self-cover versus separate cover is a variant; page counts need manufacturing validation.

references.name: Perfect-bound booklet / catalog / manual
references.distinction: Page block bonds to a wraparound cover at a square spine.
references.options: Trim size; page count; sheet caliper; computed spine; hinge; cover panels; print surfaces.
references.notes: Keep modest booklet scope; supplier minimum spine/page limits apply.

references.name: Plastic spiral-coil booklet / workbook
references.distinction: Continuous plastic coil passes through punched pages.
references.options: Trim size; page count; coil diameter/pitch; hole pattern; cover; binding edge; page rotation.
references.notes: Coil geometry and holes matter in a close-up render.

references.name: Twin-loop wire / Wire-O booklet
references.distinction: Double-loop metal wire holds punched sheets.
references.options: Trim size; sheet count; wire pitch/diameter; holes; cover; binding edge; open state.
references.notes: Vendor calls these wire coil booklets; pictured binding uses paired wire loops.

references.name: Loose-leaf instruction / refill pack
references.distinction: Ordered separate sheets, optionally punched for a binder.
references.options: Trim; count; collation; stock; drill pattern; tab positions; two-sided page mapping.
references.notes: Binder hardware can be a later assembly component.

references.name: Staple-bound pocket notebook
references.distinction: Thin card cover and folded pages share a stapled spine.
references.options: Trim; page count; cover and text calipers; staples; radius; ruling; front/back cover.
references.referenceName: Field Notes Original Kraft Memo Book
references.notes: Reference: 3.5 × 5.5 in, 48 pages, three staples. Ruling is surface artwork.

references.name: Sewn softcover notebook
references.distinction: Flexible card cover has visible stitching along the spine.
references.options: Trim; page count; thread path; cover caliper; radius; inner pocket; ruling.
references.notes: Reference includes visible Singer stitching and an inner flap pocket.

references.name: Tape-bound notebook
references.distinction: Cover panels and bookcloth spine create a distinct external binding.
references.options: Trim; block thickness; cloth-spine width; cover thickness; corner radius; decoration areas.
references.notes: External form reference; confirm internal binding before manufacturing geometry.

references.name: Hardcover journal / notebook
references.distinction: Rigid cover boards surround a sewn page block.
references.options: Trim; board/cover thickness; spine; hinges; page block; ribbon; elastic; pocket; artwork.
references.notes: Reference includes thread binding, elastic closure and gusseted back pocket.

references.name: Flexible covered journal / notebook
references.distinction: Flexible cover surrounds a thicker sewn notebook block.
references.options: Trim; page count; cover stiffness; spine; ribbon; elastic; pocket; ruling.
references.notes: Retain as a useful notebook preset sharing sewn-stack logic.

references.name: Top-bound reporter notebook
references.distinction: Narrow page block flips over a top wire binding.
references.options: Width/height; sheet count; wire geometry; top cover hinge; back pocket; ruling.
references.referenceName: Field Notes Front Page Reporter’s Notebook
references.notes: Reference has double-loop wire and a cover that protects the binding; source lists conflicting height shorthand, so measure a sample.

references.name: Top-stapled tear-off writing pad
references.distinction: Top-stapled stack has fold-back cover and removable leaves.
references.options: Width/height; sheets; staple locations; tear line; cover scores; backing board; ruling.
references.notes: Use the selected pad’s exact size chart when creating a fixed-size reference.

references.name: Glued tear-off notepad / desk pad
references.distinction: Stack adheres along one edge and sits on a backer.
references.options: Width/height; sheet count; glued edge; stock/caliper; backer; sheet artwork; optional perforation.
references.notes: Memo, shopping-list and desk-pad formats are dimensional/layout presets.

references.name: Sticky-note pad
references.distinction: Repositionable adhesive strip attaches successive notes.
references.options: Width/height/contour; sheet count; adhesive strip; caliper; sheet and pad color.
references.notes: Reference is a 90-sheet pad; cube and different-size notes are variants.

references.name: Carbonless form set / receipt pad
references.distinction: Multiple aligned sheets record a repeated written entry.
references.options: Set size; part count; paper colors; glued edge; numbering; perforation; top/back printing.
references.notes: The copy-paper coating is a material property, while sets/pads affect assembly.

references.name: Commercial correspondence envelope
references.distinction: Long-side flap with commercial seam options.
references.options: Face size; flap and seam profiles; stock; window; adhesive; front/back/flap art.
references.notes: #10 and DL should be named dimension presets, not interchangeable names.

references.name: Announcement envelope
references.distinction: Square-flap stationery envelope.
references.options: Face size; square flap depth; seams; caliper; liner; adhesive; artwork.
references.notes: A2/A7 envelope names are not the same as ISO A2/A7 paper.

references.name: Baronial envelope
references.distinction: Pointed-flap social-stationery envelope.
references.options: Face size; pointed flap profile; seams; caliper; liner; adhesive; artwork.
references.notes: Separate flap geometry from dimensions and material.

references.name: Open-end catalog envelope
references.distinction: Opening lies along the shorter edge.
references.options: Face size; flap; seams; stock; closure; window; printable regions.
references.notes: Opening edge is the key distinction from a booklet envelope.

references.name: Open-side booklet envelope
references.distinction: Opening lies along the longer edge.
references.options: Face size; flap; seams; stock; closure; window; printable regions.
references.notes: Can share nominal dimensions with catalog envelopes.

references.name: Coin / seed / small-parts envelope
references.distinction: Small open-end envelope for loose contents.
references.options: Face size; throat/flap; seam; caliper; adhesive; small-item clearance.
references.notes: Useful stationery and small-product-packaging preset.

references.name: Presentation / pocket folder
references.distinction: Folded cover has one or more glued internal pockets.
references.options: Closed/open size; pocket shapes; glue tabs; card slits; stock; inside/outside artwork.
references.notes: One/two pockets and card slits should be configuration options.

references.name: Capacity / expansion folder
references.distinction: Spine and pocket gussets add room for a thicker document stack.
references.options: Closed size; spine; pocket depth/gusset; crease network; stock; glue tabs; artwork.
references.notes: Keep actual rated capacity supplier-specific.

references.name: Gift-card holder / pocket wallet
references.distinction: Small folded carrier holds a removable card in slots or a pocket.
references.options: Closed/open size; slot or pocket; glue tabs; caliper; card clearance; print panels.
references.notes: Assembly must keep carrier and inserted card separate.

references.name: Die-cut sticker single
references.distinction: Sticker and backing are cut to the outer contour.
references.options: Contour; face stock; adhesive; liner; laminate; calipers; border; front artwork.
references.notes: Round/rectangle/custom silhouettes are contour presets.

references.name: Kiss-cut sticker single
references.distinction: Sticker contour cuts through face stock but leaves a larger backing.
references.options: Face contour; backing outline; cut depth; layers; printed border; peel state.
references.notes: Needs distinct sticker and backing outlines.

references.name: Sticker / label sheet
references.distinction: Multiple kiss-cut labels share one backing sheet.
references.options: Sheet size; contour array; spacing; face/liner caliper; artwork; peel state.
references.notes: Mixed artwork sheets and repeated-label sheets share this master.

references.name: Roll label
references.distinction: Repeated labels sit on a continuous release liner.
references.options: Label shape; web width; repeat/gap; core; winding direction; layers; applied curvature.
references.referenceName: Sticker Mule Die Cut Roll Labels
references.notes: Bottle, jar, barcode, shipping and wraparound labels are applications of this base.

references.name: Transfer decal
references.distinction: Separated design pieces are positioned by removable carrier film.
references.options: Cut paths; carrier/liner; material; printable face; spacing; installed and peel states.
references.notes: Carrier film is part of the application assembly, not the installed graphic.

references.name: Tamper-evident sealing label
references.distinction: Adhesive label bridges an opening and includes destructive slits.
references.options: Contour; slit pattern; adhesive; stock; edge bend; overlap; artwork.
references.notes: Security behavior is supplier-specific; the model represents shape and placement.

references.name: Flat hang tag / gift tag
references.distinction: Flat product tag has a hole for cord or attachment.
references.options: Contour; caliper; hole diameter/offset; eyelet; cord attachment; front/back art.
references.notes: String, plastic fastener and garment are separate components.

references.name: Folded hang tag
references.distinction: Two-panel tag adds inside print area.
references.options: Flat/folded dimensions; score; caliper; hole location; four art panels.
references.notes: Fold and attachment-hole relationships matter.

references.name: Fold-over header card / bag topper
references.distinction: Scored card folds over a bag mouth; optional hang hole.
references.options: Flat/folded size; bag width; hang hole; caliper; staple positions; two outer faces.
references.referenceName: UPrinting Bag Toppers and Header Cards
references.notes: Combine with a separate poly bag, contents and staples. A plastic bag with an integral header is PKG-037.

references.name: Backing / product display card
references.distinction: Flat card supports products through holes or slots.
references.options: Outline; thickness; mounting holes/slits; hang hole; product offset; front/back art.
references.notes: Pins, jewelry and small accessories can share this master.

references.name: Belly band / paper sleeve band
references.distinction: Printed strip wraps a product or stationery stack and overlaps.
references.options: Width; circumference; fold lines; overlap; adhesive; stock; outward artwork.
references.notes: Fit around the full assembled stack, not a single loose sheet.

references.name: Tissue wrapping / box liner sheet
references.distinction: Lightweight translucent sheet wraps or lines contents.
references.options: Sheet dimensions; GSM/caliper; translucency; creases/drape; pattern repeat; print sides.
references.notes: Manufacturer specs list 17 and 28 gsm options. GSM is not geometric thickness.

references.name: Gift wrapping paper, sheet or roll
references.distinction: Flexible printed wrapping stock supplied flat or rolled.
references.options: Sheet/roll dimensions; core; caliper; crease behavior; repeat pattern; print sides.
references.notes: Sheet and roll are supply or presentation variants.

references.name: Saddle-stitched wall calendar
references.distinction: Bound folded leaves hang open from a drilled hole.
references.options: Closed/open size; page count; staples; hang hole; stock; cover; page artwork.
references.notes: Calendar artwork is separate from the shared booklet construction.

references.name: Wire-bound wall calendar
references.distinction: Top-bound sheets hang from wire with a hanger or hole.
references.options: Sheet size; count; wire pitch/diameter; hanger; stock; cover; artwork.
references.notes: Hanging hardware is a separate part.

references.name: Desk flip calendar
references.distinction: Bound leaves flip over a freestanding folded base.
references.options: Page dimensions; sheet count; wire; stand footprint; base folds; calipers; artwork.
references.notes: Paper stand and page block are separate assembly components.

references.name: Table tent / standing information card
references.distinction: Scored card stands as a tent with a closing base.
references.options: Panel dimensions; fold angles; base tab/slot; caliper; footprint; outward artwork.
references.notes: Useful retail price/signage and event-stationery form.

references.name: Regular slotted shipping carton (RSC)
references.distinction: Four-wall tube with top and bottom flaps meeting centrally.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; board wall count, flute and caliper; joint location; tape line; outer and inner print panels.
references.notes: Custom size style; FEFCO 0201 is the standard structural counterpart.

references.name: Half-slotted open-top carton (HSC)
references.distinction: Slotted bottom flaps with an open top; a separate lid can be added.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; board grade; bottom closure; optional lid depth; print faces.
references.notes: Manufacturer's illustrated standard design, not a dimensioned stock blank.

references.name: Full-overlap shipping carton
references.distinction: Long outer flaps overlap across the closure face.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; flap overlap; board grade; closure tape and glue; print faces.
references.notes: Use exact flap layout from a supplier dieline before fabrication.

references.name: Telescoping shipping box
references.distinction: Separate inner and outer boxes slide over one another.
references.options: Inner and outer L/W; usable height; overlap; fit clearance; board thickness; graphics per component.
references.notes: Stock family; inner and outer components must be matched.

references.name: Roll-end tuck-top mailer
references.distinction: Folded multi-layer sidewalls with an attached tucking lid.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; roll-end depth; flap clearance; flute/caliper; open angle; interior and exterior graphics.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C002 Roll End Tuck Top Corrugated Box
references.notes: Custom size reference; no glue required for primary assembly.

references.name: Roll-end tuck-front mailer
references.distinction: Hinged lid closes with a front tuck arrangement.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; front tuck and side dust flaps; optional cherry locks; board caliper; lid opening; print faces.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C003 Roll End Tuck Front Corrugated Box
references.notes: Cherry locks should be a closure option. Option reference: https://pakfactory.com/style-detail-cherry-locks.html

references.name: Tab-lock roll-end mailer
references.distinction: Roll-end walls with locking tabs and slots.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; tab/slot locations; board thickness; fold clearances; interior and exterior graphics.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C001 Tab Lock Roll End Corrugated Box
references.notes: Closure variant sharing a roll-end structural master.

references.name: Three-flap-lock roll-end mailer
references.distinction: Lid closure incorporates three locking flaps.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; flap geometry and slot locations; board caliper; opening state; print faces.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C004 Roll End 3 Flap Lock Corrugated Box
references.notes: Keep distinct closure topology, while sharing the roll-end master.

references.name: One-piece corrugated mailer
references.distinction: Single die-cut blank folds into a mailer body.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; flap arrangement; score positions; board caliper; adhesive/tape zone; print surfaces.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C021 One Piece Corrugated Mailer Box
references.notes: Exact closure should follow this reference rather than generic mailer terminology.

references.name: Book-wrap mailer
references.distinction: Scored sheet wraps around a flat product.
references.options: Product L/W/thickness; score spacing; overlap; crush space; adhesive strip; inner and outer graphics.
references.referenceName: PakFactory C025 Corrugated Book Wrap Mailers
references.notes: Useful for notebooks, print sets and flat merch; adjustable-depth scores are an optional preset.

references.name: Tuck-top snap-bottom carton
references.distinction: Top tuck flap with manually interlocking bottom flaps.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; 1-2-3 bottom geometry; board caliper; top opening; print faces.
references.notes: Shares closure logic with paperboard snap-bottom cartons, but needs corrugated fold allowances.

references.name: Bottle or multipack carry carton
references.distinction: Multi-item body with integrated carry handle and dividers.
references.options: Cell count and size; handle cutout; board grade; divider geometry; graphics on body and handle.
references.notes: Use as a handled multipack reference, not only as a wine category.

references.name: Straight-tuck-end carton
references.distinction: Top and bottom tuck closures hinge from the same main panel.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; stock caliper; glue flap; dust flaps; tuck lengths; opening state; inside/outside artwork.
references.notes: Good starting reference for the user's rectangular cosmetic-style box.

references.name: Reverse-tuck-end carton
references.distinction: Top and bottom tuck closures hinge from opposite main panels.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; stock caliper; glue seam; dust flaps; tuck clearances; inside/outside artwork.
references.notes: Keep flap orientation explicit; same visual cuboid does not mean same dieline.

references.name: Tuck-top snap-lock-bottom carton
references.distinction: Top tuck closure with manually interlocking bottom flaps.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; bottom locking pattern; board caliper; top tuck; print panels.
references.referenceName: PakFactory F004 Tuck End Snap Lock Bottom
references.notes: Also called a 1-2-3 bottom; do not merge with preglued auto-bottom behavior.

references.name: Tuck-top auto-bottom carton
references.distinction: Preglued bottom erects as the flattened carton opens.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; glued bottom flaps; board caliper; top closure; folded and erected states; print panels.
references.referenceName: PakFactory F005 Tuck End Auto Bottom
references.notes: Custom manufacturing style; requires adhesive relationships in assembly.

references.name: Seal-end carton
references.distinction: End flaps are glued rather than repeatedly tucked.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; end flap overlaps; glue zones; paperboard caliper; tear feature; graphics.
references.notes: Useful for carton graphics and opening simulations; glue zones should be marked.

references.name: Four-sided paperboard sleeve
references.distinction: Four-panel band wraps a product or inner tray.
references.options: Wrapped perimeter; band width; stock caliper; glue overlap; fit clearance; external artwork.
references.notes: Precreased tube-like sleeve. A narrow wraparound belly band is the related PAP-055 preset.

references.name: Pillow box
references.distinction: Curved body with bowed end flaps.
references.options: Body length/width; bulge depth; arc geometry; paperboard thickness; end opening; graphics.
references.notes: Requires curved folding behavior, not a rectangular-box approximation.

references.name: Five-panel hanging carton
references.distinction: Tuck carton extended into a rear hanging panel.
references.options: Carton L/W/H; header height; hang-hole type and position; board caliper; graphics on box and hanger.
references.notes: Useful for cable/accessory retail displays.

references.name: Bookend carton
references.distinction: Carton body with an additional front-opening cover panel.
references.options: Body L/W/H; cover width; hinge; closure; optional window; outside and inside cover graphics.
references.notes: Different from a rigid book-style box despite similar opening metaphor.

references.name: Four-corner open tray
references.distinction: Paperboard base with four folding/glued corners.
references.options: Base L/W; wall height; corner construction; caliper; interior/exterior graphics.
references.notes: Can serve as a component in a tray-and-sleeve assembly.

references.name: Six-corner hinged-lid box
references.distinction: Tray and attached lid formed with folded/glued corner construction.
references.options: Base L/W/H; lid depth; hinge; glue corners; paperboard caliper; print surfaces.
references.notes: A collapsible folding-carton structure, not a rigid setup box.

references.name: Two-piece paperboard tray and lid
references.distinction: Separate folded tray and covering lid.
references.options: Tray L/W/H; lid overlap; fit clearance; doubled wall geometry; paperboard caliper; graphics per part.
references.referenceName: PakFactory F076 Double Wall Tray & Lid
references.notes: Double wall here describes folded sidewall construction, not corrugated wall count.

references.name: Paperboard drawer box
references.distinction: Folded inner tray slides within an outer sleeve.
references.options: Tray L/W/H; sleeve clearance; pull notch/tab; caliper; extended state; graphics per component.
references.referenceName: PakFactory F077 Double Wall Tray & Sleeve
references.notes: Shares sliding behavior with a rigid drawer, but uses folding paperboard.

references.name: Gable carry box
references.distinction: Rectangular body rises to a gabled top with carry handle.
references.options: Body L/W/H; gable rise; handle shape; top interlock; bottom style; paperboard caliper; graphics.
references.notes: Useful for gift and event packaging without creating a food-only category.

references.name: Lift-off lid setup box
references.distinction: Rigid base and separate lid overlap telescopically.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; lid overlap; clearance; chipboard and wrap thickness; wrapped inner/outer print surfaces.
references.notes: Short, full-depth and partial-depth lids are parameters.

references.name: Shoulder-and-neck box
references.distinction: Inner shoulder locates a lid and may leave an exposed band.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; collar height; reveal gap; board/wrap thickness; lid fit; artwork per component.
references.notes: Separate base, collar and lid components.

references.name: Rigid drawer box
references.distinction: Rigid inner tray slides inside a surrounding sleeve.
references.options: Internal L/W/H; sleeve fit; pull ribbon/notch; chipboard and wrap thickness; print surfaces.
references.notes: Opening amount is a scene state.

references.name: Book-style hinged rigid box
references.distinction: Tray attached to a hinged wraparound cover.
references.options: Tray L/W/H; spine width; cover overhang; hinge; magnet/ribbon closure; chipboard/wrap; artwork.
references.referenceName: PakFactory RP008 Book Style Rigid Box
references.notes: Magnetic closure is a feature within the master rather than a material category.

references.name: Collapsible rigid gift box
references.distinction: Rigid panels connected by folding sections, assembled into a box.
references.options: L/W/H; panel thickness; collapsible corners; closure; adhesive positions; flat/erected state; artwork.
references.notes: Needs separate flat and erected representations.

references.name: Round rigid presentation box
references.distinction: Rigid cylindrical body and fitted lid.
references.options: Internal diameter/height; wall and lid thickness; overlap; seams; wrap circumference; lid-disc graphics.
references.notes: Reference for candle, hat, gift and cylindrical product packaging.

references.name: Open-top flat poly bag
references.distinction: Two film faces joined at sides and bottom, open at top.
references.options: Lay-flat width; usable length; seam width; film polymer/gauge; transparency; fill thickness; print faces.
references.referenceName: ClearBags No Flap Open Top Crystal Clear Bags
references.notes: Stock family; select exact size and film grade. Appropriate bag base for a separate stapled header.

references.name: Adhesive flap-seal bag
references.distinction: Extended flap folds over and adheres to the bag.
references.options: Body W/H; flap depth; adhesive location; film gauge; closure state; transparency; print faces.

materialOptions.choices: Uncoated writing/text paper; coated matte or gloss; cover/card; kraft; translucent tissue.
materialOptions.details: Record paper family, GSM, measured caliper, grain, color, texture and opacity independently.

materialOptions.choices: Named supplier stock in GSM plus caliper in mm or micrometres.
materialOptions.details: GSM is mass per area. Do not derive sheet thickness from GSM without a specific stock reference.

materialOptions.choices: Matte; gloss; foil; spot gloss; raised gloss; letterpress.
materialOptions.details: Keep the base stock, coating and artwork operations separate. Store the intended face and print area.

materialOptions.choices: US Letter, Legal, Tabloid; ISO A-series; postcards; custom rectangles; rounded corners; custom contour.
materialOptions.details: Store numeric dimensions with units. Use named sizes as presets. Distinguish finished trim from bleed.

materialOptions.choices: Half; C/letter; Z; accordion; gate; closed gate; roll; double parallel; French; compound map folds.
materialOptions.details: Store ordered panel widths and fold directions, flat size and finished footprint. Nested folds may need unequal panels.

materialOptions.choices: Saddle stitch; glued spine; plastic coil; twin-loop wire; sewn; glued pad; loose leaves.
materialOptions.details: Record sheet count separately from page count, individual calipers, cover stock, binding edge and hardware.

materialOptions.choices: White or clear film; paper; kraft; metallic; holographic; coated or laminated face.
materialOptions.details: Store face stock, adhesive, release liner and finish separately. Cut contour and backing contour can differ.

materialOptions.choices: Commercial; announcement; baronial; open-end catalog; open-side booklet; coin.
materialOptions.details: Record face dimensions, opening edge, seam and flap. US announcement envelope names differ from ISO paper names.

materialOptions.choices: Single face; single wall; double wall; triple wall.
materialOptions.details: Single face is a liner and exposed fluting. Closed walls use additional liners. Keep wall count separate from flute profile.

materialOptions.choices: A, B, C, E, F; combined EB and BC for double-wall examples.
materialOptions.details: Use a supplier's actual caliper and flute direction. Letter names are not a thickness ranking or universal exact measurement.

materialOptions.choices: Solid bleached board; folding boxboard; kraft/uncoated; recycled board; wrapped rigid chipboard.
materialOptions.details: Store thickness, stiffness, grain, liner/wrap, inside/outside finish and fold construction independently.

materialOptions.choices: Straight/reverse tuck; snap-lock/1-2-3 bottom; auto/crash-lock bottom; glued seal; cherry locks; tabs and slots.
materialOptions.details: Closures can modify a compatible body. Preserve flap geometry, glue regions and open/closed states.
materialOptions.referenceName: PakFactory structure library and cherry locks

materialOptions.choices: Die-cut window; clear window patch; hang hole/Euro slot; thumb notch; tear strip; raised header.
materialOptions.details: Store the opening and optional clear film as separate features or parts. Position graphics relative to cuts and folds.

materialOptions.choices: PE/LDPE; PP/BOPP; clear, frosted or opaque; metallized or laminated barrier structures.
materialOptions.details: Record polymer/laminate, gauge in micrometres or mil, transparency, seams and stiffness. Film gauge is actual thickness.

materialOptions.choices: Open top; lip-and-tape; zipper; slider; heat seal; separate topper; integral hanging header.
materialOptions.details: Record lay-flat width, usable body height, gussets and fill depth. Header, flap, zipper and sealed regions consume space.

materialOptions.choices: Paperboard; corrugated; molded pulp; thermoformed plastic; PU, EPE or EVA foam.
materialOptions.details: For foam, preserve density, firmness, surface texture, color, block thickness and cavity shape as separate options.

materialOptions.choices: Fitted; regular; relaxed; boxy; oversized; cropped; longline; dropped shoulder.
materialOptions.details: Use measured chest, body length, shoulder, armhole and sleeve dimensions per size. Fit and fabric weight are independent.

materialOptions.choices: Single jersey; rib; pique; brushed fleece; loopback/French terry; mesh; poplin/oxford; twill; canvas; nylon shell; terry towel.
materialOptions.details: Keep fiber content, knit/weave, face and reverse texture, stretch, thickness, mass and stiffness as separate material fields.

materialOptions.choices: AS Colour Basic 5051: 160 GSM; Staple 5001: 180 GSM; Classic 5026: 220 GSM; Heavy 5080: 280 GSM.
materialOptions.details: These are manufacturer reference points, not universal light/medium/heavy thresholds. Physical thickness and drape remain separate.

materialOptions.choices: Independent Avenue IND280SL: 280 g/m2; Mainstreet IND420XD: 420 g/m2; Legend IND5000P: 450 g/m2.
materialOptions.details: Retain the manufacturer's stated weight and exact fabric composition. Lining, rib, hood and body may use different materials.

materialOptions.choices: Manufacturer-specific adult, youth, toddler and infant size sets.
materialOptions.details: Record finished garment measurements and reference size. A size chart does not supply all sewable pattern pieces or cloth simulation values.

materialOptions.choices: Screen print; DTG; transfer/DTF; embroidery; applique; sewn patch; garment dye or wash.
materialOptions.details: Store print regions and seam interruptions. Add separate geometry for sewn labels and patches; transfers can be applied graphics.
materialOptions.referenceName: AS Colour Staple Tee decoration options

materialOptions.choices: Five/six panels; structured/unstructured; low/mid/high crown; flat/curved bill; mesh back; buckle/snap/fitted/stretch closure.
materialOptions.details: Record crown panel shapes, brim width/curve/thickness, closure and printable or embroiderable areas.
materialOptions.referenceName: Flexfit and YP Classics hat catalog

materialOptions.choices: Flat or gusseted panels; lining; boxed corners; webbing handles; zipper; drawstring; pockets; padded insert.
materialOptions.details: Record shell and lining separately, seam allowances when available, handle path, opening and useful interior dimensions.

materialOptions.choices: Flat; end fold; center/loop fold; Manhattan/hem wrap; mitre fold.
materialOptions.details: Record finished exposed area and full cut dimensions, folds, sew-in allowance, substrate and front/reverse artwork.
materialOptions.referenceName: Dutch Label Shop label fold guide

materialOptions.choices: Wire staple; plastic loop; string loop; adhesive hang tab; hook-and-loop tie; packing tape.
materialOptions.details: Keep fasteners as independent components with placement and material dimensions, so assemblies can be previewed open or closed.

workExamples.name: Coiled USB-C cable retail pack
workExamples.components: Imported cable in coiled state; optional reusable tie; open-top poly bag; fold-over header; staples.
workExamples.sizing: Use the stated 4-inch circle as a starting outer-diameter target. Coil depth and connector envelope determine the filled bag size. Cable length alone does not.
workExamples.surfaces: Cable surfaces, header front/back, optional bag printing.
workExamples.notes: Keep the cable, bag, card and each fastener separately selectable.

workExamples.name: Rectangular carton with accordion instructions
workExamples.components: Imported product; straight- or reverse-tuck carton; optional retaining insert; accordion manual.
workExamples.sizing: Fit the product, folded manual stack and optional insert inside usable internal dimensions. Allow for flap intrusion and opening access.
workExamples.surfaces: Named carton faces, interior, ordered manual panels.
workExamples.notes: The two tuck variants are alternative cartons, not simultaneous components.

workExamples.name: T-shirt retail and shipping pack
workExamples.components: T-shirt; woven neck/hem label; care label; hang tag and loop; flap bag; shipping mailer; thank-you card.
workExamples.sizing: Use folded garment volume. Keep the tag attachment and label sew-in areas separate from printing.
workExamples.surfaces: Front/back/sleeves, sewn labels, hang tag, bag, outer mailer and card.
workExamples.notes: Label fold can change without changing the garment family.

workExamples.name: Notebook stationery set
workExamples.components: Stapled pocket notebook; postcard; sticker sheet; belly band; rigid document or book-wrap mailer.
workExamples.sizing: Band fits around the complete stack. Select one mailer around the finished set.
workExamples.surfaces: Notebook cover, individual card/stickers, outward band panels and mailer.

workExamples.name: Small accessory in presentation box
workExamples.components: Imported object; cut-cavity foam or folded paper insert; shoulder-neck or drawer rigid box; information card.
workExamples.sizing: Cavity matches the product plus selected clearance. Check lid and drawer travel around the contained parts.
workExamples.surfaces: Rigid-box wrap, insert surface, information card.
workExamples.notes: Choose one insert construction and one box construction.

workExamples.name: Hanging carded blister
workExamples.components: Imported object; formed clear blister; face-seal flange; printed backing card.
workExamples.sizing: Cavity depth fits the product. Keep seal flange, hang hole and readable card area available.
workExamples.surfaces: Backing-card front/reverse and any approved plastic decoration.
workExamples.notes: Distinct from a loose blister tray placed inside a carton.

workExamples.name: Shipped art print
workExamples.components: Flat print or rolled print; protective sheet; rigid flat mailer or capped mailing tube; shipping label.
workExamples.sizing: Choose flat or rolled state. Tube diameter depends on allowed roll curvature and protective layer.
workExamples.surfaces: Artwork, exterior mailer or tube, shipping label.
workExamples.notes: Flat and rolled packaging are alternative assemblies.

workExamples.name: Counter display with refill units
workExamples.components: Raised-header display carton; repeated retail packs; optional divider; shelf/display graphics.
workExamples.sizing: Lay out repeated pack footprints inside the tray. Preserve transit and open display states.
workExamples.surfaces: Tray front, sides, header front/back and each unit pack.
workExamples.notes: The display is a parent assembly containing repeated product packages.
